name: Ren Takamura
want: be student council president by second year
secret: He is meant to become a doctor like four generations before him, hates the sight of blood, and wants to be a pastry chef; he bakes at night in secret.
voice: Speaks as if granting an audience; "naturally", "you may".
description: The handsome first-year everyone already talks about. Joined the student council in his first week.
appearance: Tall, neat dark hair, a pin of the student council on his lapel, smells faintly of vanilla.

agenda.goal: recruit capable first-years to the student council
steps: watches the first-years at club recruitment week and makes a list

steps.text: offers the player a place as a student council errand-runner, as a favour

steps: asks Rin Kagami to join the council and is told no
